authorship: Expected values and priority/timing rules specified before production fixes; reference uses supplied signals, not production detector logic.
rounding: Decimal input text; adverse/outward tick rounding; cash and borrowing retain fractional cents until display.

changing_short_notional.reason: 19 * (100+101+102) * 0.365 / (365*1440); each minute uses the opening mark known at its start.

last_session_minute.reason: One exposed trading minute at 19*$100; charge is present in that session's daily equity, before the overnight interval.

older_pending_first.reason: BBB's older limit and AAA's newer market order become fillable together; signal availability precedes symbol in portfolio order priority.

configuration_priority.reason: Equal-time/equal-symbol candidates sort by configuration identity, then signal identity. Reversing opaque signal IDs cannot reverse the configuration priority.

same_close_mark.reason: At the close, $10,000 equity with a 50% symbol cap permits 50 shares marked at100. An earlier open110 is not the closing risk mark.

same_close_other_position.reason: 25 BBB shares rise from100 to200, so equity is12500 at the close; a 25% AAA cap permits floor3125/100=31 shares.

new_limit_gap.reason: Conservative limit entry100 with opening market95 has its stop98 already breached. Exit at opening95 less one adverse cent, rather than inventing an executable97.99 stop fill.

nonpositive_rounded_target.reason: A short at0.08 with stop0.13 and1.5R produces0.005 before rounding and0.00 on a0.01 grid; zero is not a tradable target.

exposure_decimal_boundary.reason: Capital100 * exposure0.29 permits29 shares marked at1.00.

target_exact_trade_through.reason: High is exactly one cent through target, so it qualifies; binary addition must not require another cent.

limit_price_grid.reason: A buy must not exceed its declared maximum and a sell must not undershoot its minimum; round their limit toward the permissible side of the grid.
